title: MemFolder: Structure-Guided Memory Folding for Efficient Agent Memory Management
abstract: arXiv:2611.26427v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-term agents accumulate large external memory stores as interactions unfold, increasing the costs of storage, retrieval, and response generation. Efficiency is constrained by two coupled factors: a growing record count increases retrieval overhead, while longer retrieved contexts increase prefill computation and decoding-time attention costs. Existing methods prune or consolidate records, but pruning can discard useful evidence, whereas consolidation may produce fewer yet longer retrieval units. We introduce MemFolder, a structure-guided memory folding framework that sequentially reduces record count and context length. The framework comprises two core components that share memory groups, using cross-record structure to guide both evidence consolidation and compact representation. translated_title: MemFolder：面向高效智能体记忆管理的结构引导记忆折叠
translated_abstract: 长期运行的智能体在交互过程中会不断累积大量外部记忆存储，从而增加存储、检索和响应生成的成本。其效率受到两个耦合因素的制约：记录数量的增长会增加检索开销，而更长的检索上下文则会增加预填充计算和解码阶段的注意力成本。现有方法对记录进行剪枝或合并，但剪枝可能丢弃有用的证据，而合并则可能产生数量更少但更长的检索单元。我们提出了MemFolder，一个结构引导的记忆折叠框架，能够依次降低记录数量和上下文长度。该框架包含两个共享记忆分组的核心组件，利用跨记录结构来同时指导证据合并与紧凑表示。其中RecordFolder对实体提及进行接地，逐步选择具有代表性且互补的锚点，并将语义与实体亲和性同时间信息相结合……
tldr: 提出了结构引导的记忆折叠框架MemFolder，通过共享记忆分组的证据合并与紧凑表示两个核心组件，依次降低记录数量和上下文长度，实现更高效的长期智能体记忆管理。
